description: Read and act on website and asset feedback from Simple Commenter in ChatGPT and Codex. Search authorized projects, inspect comments with available screenshots, element context, replies, and captured JavaScript errors, and turn feedback into concrete development tasks. With the appropriate permissions, update statuses and priorities, reply to feedback, create comments, and generate exports and reports. The included fix-feedback skill guides a coding agent through investigating and fixing selected issues when the relevant codebase is available. Requires a Simple Commenter account and project access. Features depend on your account plan and granted permissions.

defaultPrompt: Show open feedback for my website, grouped by priority.
Find feedback about the pricing page and summarize the reported problems.
Investigate the highest-priority feedback item using its screenshot and page context.
